text:
sam_sales: Handover for AtlasGrid — signed yesterday. Main asks: private deployment (VPC), SAML SSO, and a custom connector to their legacy DB. Moving to CS for activation and runbook. looping @elaine_cs and @priya_csops
elaine_cs: Thanks Sam — I'll own engagement. Quick Q: do we have the IdP metadata (entity ID / cert)?
sam_sales: Yes — have IdP URL and cert. Dropping quick snippet: ```idp_entity: https://idp.atlas.example/saml
idp_sso: https://idp.atlas.example/sso
idp_cert: https://files.redwood/secure/atlas-cert.pem```
priya_csops: Noted. I'll spin up the onboarding ticket and checklist. Expected go-live window? Also need the technical contact name/email.
sam_sales: They want a POC in ~2 weeks, GA in 6 weeks. Tech contact: Jordan Lee (jordan@atlasgrid.com). Also flagged compliance milestone: SOC2 evidence requested within 90 days.
elaine_cs: Action items (owners): 1) VPC provisioning — miguel_platform 2) SAML setup — miguel_platform 3) Connector spec + ingestion plan — priya_csops 4) CS enablement call with AtlasGrid — elaine_cs 5) Compliance evidence handoff to support/legal — kara_support. Please ack or reassign.
miguel_platform: I'll take provisioning + SAML. Need the IdP cert file and the ACS (assertion consumer) URL from us. Note: infra will require 10.0.5.0/24 for peering. I'll open INF ticket.
kara_support: I'll start the compliance thread with legal to pull SOC2 artifacts. Heads up: if they require on-prem evals, we may need premium support SLA. Tagging support lead in separate DM.
priya_csops: Creating CS ticket now: CS-4731 with checklist items. Draft connector spec uploaded to GDrive: https://docs.redwood/atlasgrid-connector (internal).
sam_sales: Forwarded to Jordan and asked for cert and test window. Jordan confirmed Wed 10am PT for the onboarding call. Secure cert link above.
elaine_cs: I booked Wed 10am PT for enablement. Priya / Miguel — please ensure INF + CS tickets have test credentials ready at least 24h prior. Kara — can you confirm SOC2 pack by Monday EOD?
miguel_platform: INF-1122 opened for VPC + SAML. Provision ETA 48h. I'll post the test endpoint to the ticket when ready.
oncall-bot: INF-1122 assigned to miguel_platform (SLA: 48h).
priya_csops: Checklist updated in CS-4731: confirm cert, provision VPC, connector spec, test creds, enablement deck. ETA: initial checklist by EOD tomorrow.
elaine_cs: Renewal/compliance note: flag to AM for 90-day SOC2 milestone and monitor renewal risk. @sam_sales can you add CRM reminder?
sam_sales: Done — CRM updated, 60d reminder set, added tag "private-deploy".
elaine_cs: Owners recap: miguel_platform = infra + SAML, priya_csops = onboarding ticket + connector spec, kara_support = compliance evidence, elaine_cs = CS enablement and success plan. Next sync Tue EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your tasks are acknowledged.
